title: Phagosome as the vacuole Mtb argues with
dek: Wikipedia's phagosome page is the organelle. ESX-1 membrane damage and arrest of maturation stay on tb-phagosome-arrest.
story: A phagosome on Wikipedia is the vesicle formed around eaten cargo, expected to mature toward a degradative phagolysosome. That default is what Mtb interrupts.
Simplfy already has a mechanism plate for phagosome arrest. This card is the organelle name so the concept map can point at that mechanism without pasting it.
ESX-1 / ESAT-6 damage to the phagosomal membrane is a TB-specific plot twist — esx and esat6 plates — not a generic encyclopedia phagocytosis cartoon.
deep: Markers (Rab5, Rab7, LAMP-1) are how cell biologists argue about arrest. They are not clinical tests.
Cytosolic contact after membrane damage is a research-layer object with STING/type I IFN stories; do not turn it into a DST.
Drugs that need acidic niches (PZA folklore adjacent) should still be dosed from WHO, with lesion PK on caseum plates.
Autophagy cross-talk is neighbouring literature, not a cartridge.

visual.caption: Default maturation downward; Mtb veto sideways toward arrest or membrane damage. Those vetoes are other plates.

example.takeaway: Phagosome is the argument's venue. Mtb often wins the first round.
